text:
The statements describe what happens when the power of a machine is increased.
1
The work done in a given time decreases.
2
The work done in a given time increases.
3
The time taken to do a given quantity of work decreases.
4
The time taken to do a given quantity of work increases.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Physics
